findings.title: 会话组织类别切换无提示丢弃未提交编辑
findings.body: 项目、分区、当前会话使用互斥组件分支。切换类别卸载编辑器，项目草稿和分区编辑仅保存在子组件 useState；再次返回重新初始化，已输入内容无提示丢失。
reproduction: 打开会话组织 → 会话项目 → 创建或编辑项目，输入名称/元数据但不保存。
切换分区或当前会话，再返回会话项目；编辑表单及输入消失。
在分区新增或编辑名称/图标/颜色时执行相同切换，也会丢失。
evidence: OrganizationPanel.tsx:50 changes the category unconditionally; lines 59-86 render mutually exclusive children.
NativeProjects.tsx:39-43 stores selected/draft locally; draft fields at 250-395.
ThreadOrganization.tsx:34 stores SectionSettings edit locally; edit form at 86-135.
exclusions: 不把主动关闭对话框或明确更换操作目标计作此缺陷。
子组件仅作定向证据核验，全文覆盖归根代理单独报告。

findings.title: 设置类别切换会丢失供应商和连接编辑
findings.body: 除模型账户外，设置页按类别条件卸载其面板。用户在供应商页面填写非敏感配置后切换类别核对账户或其他配置，再返回时这些输入被服务端已保存值覆盖；MCP 配置和远端环境登记也有相同卸载路径。刷新时的 dirty 检查不能保护跨卸载编辑。
reproduction: 设置 → 模型供应商，修改端点、模型、推理强度或 OAuth 公共配置但不保存。
切到通用/模型账户，再切回模型供应商；输入恢复为读取到的已保存配置。
MCP 中编辑配置，或远端环境登记中输入名称/地址后切换设置类别再返回，未保存编辑同样消失。
evidence: Settings.tsx:89 unconditionally changes category; lines 151-159, 182-220 conditionally mount affected panels.
ProviderSettings.tsx:43-56 stores form and dirty marker inside component; lines 65-86 initialize from read data after mount.
McpConfiguration.tsx:136-140 stores edit locally; RemoteSettings.tsx:54-58 stores registration name/url locally.
exclusions: Settings accountMounted branch retains AccountSettings/AccountToolsPanel and is excluded.
授权勾选、密码、token 可在切换时按策略清空；本问题要求保护非敏感输入或给出明确弃改提示，不要求保留秘密或自动确认。
ConfigSettings has a module drafts Map and does retain its configuration edits.

findings.title: 扩展分类切换丢弃技能正文与共享编辑
findings.body: 扩展类别使用互斥子组件。即使项目范围未变，切换到其他类别核对信息也会卸载 SkillSettings/PluginSettings/PluginSharing，使尚未提交的技能正文、市场来源或接收者编辑全部丢失，界面没有脏编辑保护。
reproduction: 设置 → 扩展与配置 → 技能与 Hooks，展开新建/导入技能，填写目录名和多行 SKILL.md 正文，尚未点保存本地草稿。
切换 Apps/配置与功能，再返回技能与 Hooks；目录名和正文为空。
插件与市场中输入市场 URL/ref，或插件共享中编辑接收者后执行类别往返，同样清空。
evidence: ExtensionsPanel.tsx:63 switches category with no dirty check; lines 74-153 unmount alternate category components.
SkillSettings.tsx:58-64 nests SkillCreator; SkillLibraryTools.tsx:187-194 holds unprepared slug/text only in useState.
PluginSettings.tsx:31-36 stores market source/ref locally; PluginSharing.tsx:143-153 and 300-309 stores audience locally.
exclusions: 已经点击保存本地草稿的 SkillCreator 内容通过 file-drafts 持久保留，排除该阶段。
ConfigSettings edits use a module drafts Map and are excluded.
仅在同一项目内切换类别复现，不把明确改变项目/插件目标作为本条触发。

findings.title: 切换 MCP 工具和资源类别清空工具参数
findings.body: 工具类别中的 McpArguments 在切换资源或事件订阅时被卸载。选中的服务和工具保留在父层，因此返回时仍显示同一个工具，却重新创建空参数编辑器；先填写参数再查看资源的正常流程丢失输入。
reproduction: 在已发现工具的 MCP 服务中选一个工具，填写普通 Schema 字段或 JSON 参数但不调用。
切换资源或事件订阅，然后返回工具；仍选中原工具，但所有参数变为空值或 {}。
evidence: McpPanel.tsx:91-106 holds selected/tool/template/URI/stream input in parent state.
McpPanel.tsx:464 changes tab; lines 470-501 conditionally mount McpArguments.
McpArguments.tsx:34-38 holds values/raw/advanced only in local state.
exclusions: MCP resource URI and event-stream text are parent-owned and survive internal category switches.
明确切换到不同工具或不同服务可重新初始化；本复现保持同一工具与服务。
调用授权应重新核对；本条不要求保留授权确认。

findings.title: 切换项目文件与 Git 页面丢弃提交说明
findings.body: Git 面板只在当前类别为 git 时挂载，WorkspaceCommit 的作者、邮箱和提交说明没有上提或缓存。用户编写提交说明后进入文件视图核对改动，再回到 Git 时所有字段被清空，长提交说明无法恢复。
reproduction: 同一项目打开 Git，展开提交已暂存的修改，输入作者、邮箱及多行提交说明，但不提交。
切到文件查看改动，再回 Git；提交表单重新挂载，作者、邮箱和说明均为空。
evidence: WorkspacePanel.tsx:359/366 changes files/git tab; lines 416-451 render mutually exclusive panels.
WorkspaceCommit.tsx:20-26 stores name/email/text/confirmation only in local state.
exclusions: FileEditor uses its explicit file-draft cache and is excluded.
Workspace top-level files/terminal/process navigation uses hidden retained slots and is not the cause.
暂存区快照与提交确认应重新校验；需要保留的是文本草稿。

method: Full manual semantic reading of all 124 assigned non-test web files, including every component/hook/library implementation, seven CSS files, entry/configuration files and VERIFICATION.md. Traced async ownership, stale completion, mutation/receipt/approval boundaries, draft lifetime, user navigation and accessibility controls. VERIFICATION.md was inspected as current source documentation only; its historical audit/test claims were not used as current correctness evidence. A follow-up cross-cutting scan of every setTab/setView category container confirmed five source-reproducible lost-edit paths and excluded parent-owned/cached/retained views. No tests, browser sessions, type/build checks or live integrations were executed by this reviewer. The 65 web tests and four explicitly delegated components are covered only by separate root reports.

coverageBatches.method: full semantic source reading; VERIFICATION.md current-document consistency only, historical conclusions not adopted
